hlst-01-c1.text: Marek Jankowiak (2017). The first Arab siege of Constantinople: The campaign of Yazid b. Mu'awiyah in 667-669. Byzantion'dan Constantinopolis'e Istanbul Kusatmalari (Istanbul Arastirmalari Enstitusu), pp. 201-228; University of Birmingham research portal.
hlst-01-c1.quote: rather than in 674-8, the first Arab attempt to conquer the Roman capital took place in 667-9 and was led by the son of the reigning caliph.
hlst-01-c1.claim: the historian Marek Jankowiak has argued that the main Arab attack came earlier, in 667 to 669
